At some point between [[32 BBY/Legends|32 BBY]] and [[19 BBY/Legends|19 BBY]], [[Supreme Chancellor/Legends|Supreme Chancellor]] [[Palpatine/Legends|Palpatine]] of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] dispatched a team of agents on a '''mission''' to the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Puloorn]] to investigate the rumored existence of a ruined [[Sith temple (Puloorn)|Sith temple]].<ref name="RCRB">''[[Star Wars Roleplaying Game Revised Core Rulebook]]''</ref>
